info.name: The One Who Walks Down Memory Lane2

descriptions.notStarted: As #p2140000# said, I was able to pass #m270010100# and go all the way to #m270010200#.  But I couldn't move beyond that... I thought I was given permission, what's going on?  I'm going to have to complain to #b#p2140000##k.
descriptions.inProgress: He said the permission he gave me was only up to #m270010200#, and that if I wanted to go in further,  I would have to prove myself for that as well.  When I told him that I definitely want to explore more, he said to go to #b#m270010200##k this time and defeat #r999 #o8200002##k... \n\n#o8200002# #r#a35021##k
descriptions.completed: I defeated 999 #o8200002#.  #p2140000# was once again impressed and granted me permission.  I get a feeling that this permission is only good up to #m270010300#.  If I want to go in further, will I have to prove my strength again?
